messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up: were finalizing site copy + CTA behavior for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages ahead of the benchmarks post and companion webinar. Need quick decisions on microcopy + form routing so dev can ship by Friday.

Priya Singh: Quick principle: hosted = frictionless self-serve. Dedicated = hand-raising with performance signals. Private = sales-first with compliance assets. Keep CTAs consistent but tuned to intent.

Ben Cole: Draft CTA set idea: Hosted primary = "Try hosted API free" / secondary = "See latency & pricing". Dedicated primary = "Request a dedicated walkthrough" / secondary = "View throughput benchmarks". Private primary = "Talk to sales about private deploy" / secondary = "Compliance & SOC docs".

Noah Kim: Routing details: Hosted -> signup flow (utm_source=site&utm_campaign=hosted_cta). Dedicated -> lead form posts to /leads/dedicated with `source=dedicated_site` and a hidden `tier_estimate` question for SDRs. Private -> AE queue + auto-attach `compliance_packet` email.

Maya Patel: Can we make the Dedicated form include a dropdown for expected QPS and preferred latency? That will help SDRs triage. Also we need a canonical UTM schema for webinar promo so analytics ties back to page variants.

Priya Singh: Love the form fields. For hero copy alternatives (three short options each):

Hosted: 
- "Hosted inference, predictable performance, zero infra"
- "Start building with a fast hosted inference API"
- "Launch LLM features with a managed inference API"

Dedicated: 
- "Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput"
- "Dedicated capacity with SLA-backed latency"
- "Guaranteed throughput for production LLMs"

Private: 
- "Bring inference behind your VPC or on-prem"
- "Private deployments with enterprise controls"
- "Air-gapped or VPC-hosted inference for compliance-sensitive apps"

Ben Cole: My pick: Hosted option 2, Dedicated option 1, Private option 2. Short, clear, different tone.

Noah Kim: Analytics ask: append `page_variant=hero_b` for A/B test. Also track which CTA clicked: `cta=primary|secondary|trial`.

Jordan (growth-bot): :robot_face: webinar segment suggestion: attendees who requested Dedicated demo in last 6 months + those who visited /pricing and stayed > 60s. I can export that list.

Maya Patel: Webinar content plan (high level): 1) quick primer on serving tradeoffs, 2) live benchmark walkthrough (latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens), 3) customer case study (Dedicated customer), 4) Q&A. Need a 10-slide deck and a short blog post (500-700 words) to promote.

Priya Singh: For the benchmark slide, we should present median p95 latency, throughput (tokens/sec), and cost delta at 1k-token request shape. Call out KV-cache and batching assumptions.

Ben Cole: I'll run the benchmarking script Monday and output CSVs. Will include: hosted (standard runtime), dedicated quantized on A100, and private on a 4xV100-like baseline.

Maya Patel: Copy for the dedicated CTA copy variants to test in the hero (two short alternatives):
- "Request dedicated walkthrough"
- "Book a throughput demo"
Please pick one for default and one for the A variant.

Noah Kim: I'll stub the form endpoints and the hidden UTM rules. ETA Thursday.

Maya Patel: Ok action list: Ben = bench runs + CSVs, Noah = form + UTM, Priya = finalize hero picks + blog outline, Jordan = pull webinar invite list, Maya = draft launch blog and webinar invite. Deadline: Thursday EOD for final copy so eng can deploy on Friday.

Priya Singh: Noted. I'll post final hero choices by Wednesday noon.

Ben Cole: Will share raw numbers by Monday evening.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone. Small ask: avoid phrasing like "enterprise-ready" on hosting page hero. Keep enterprise signals on Dedicated/Private. Ping me if anything blocks. :raised_hands:
